Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 94: March 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #94 shipped to subscribers in February 2009 (bearing the cover date of March 2009 for Issue 94). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #94 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, bonus DLC, and exclusive media previews:

Wheelman (open-world driving action)
Guitar Hero: Metallica (rhythm music game)
X-Men Origins: Wolverine (third-person action hack-and-slash)
Peggle (Xbox Live Arcade casual puzzle game)
Outrun Online Arcade (Xbox Live Arcade arcade racing)
Lode Runner (Xbox Live Arcade action puzzle-platformer)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for BioShock 2, Modern Warfare 2, and Assassin's Creed II, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
